full_prompt_en: A square nineteenth-century-style oil portrait shows a seated young man in a crimson coat before a mottled brown studio backdrop. The upper half of the background is quiet but richly worked, with charcoal-brown paint at the left and warmer ochre clouds behind the sitter's right shoulder. A narrow gilded border is visible along the far left edge. The man sits slightly left of center, his dark curled hair framing a pale, warmly lit face and a small neat moustache. He looks outward with a composed, direct expression. A white shirt rises under a dark bow at his throat, and a patterned brown waistcoat shows between the open lapels of the red coat. The coat has broad shoulders and full sleeves, its heavy fabric described through broken maroon, brick-red, and dark rose brushstrokes. His left forearm rests lower across the lap, while the other arm extends to the right and a pale hand hangs loosely over an unseen support. Across the lower portion, warm tan trousers form a broad diagonal wedge, with the nearest folds touched by muted golden light. The seat and room dissolve into deep shadow rather than becoming individually detailed objects. Face and hands have smooth, careful modeling, but jacket, waistcoat, and background remain active with short, irregular strokes and softened edges. Light falls from the upper left and front, catching the forehead, cheek, white collar, knuckles, and raised ridges of the coat; the area behind the elbow stays dark. Shadows are warm brown rather than flat black, and they merge the figure with the atmospheric ground. The overall composition places a dignified, relaxed figure within a shallow field of earthy darkness, with crimson fabric and small pale highlights carrying the visual emphasis.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、带十九世纪气息的油画肖像呈现一位身穿深红外套的年轻男子，坐在斑驳的棕色画室背景前。背景上半部安静，却有丰富的颜料经营：左边是炭褐色，人物右肩后方浮出较暖的赭色云状色层。最左边缘可见一条窄窄的镀金画框。男子坐在中央略偏左处，深色卷发围着受暖光照亮的浅色面庞，唇上有整洁的小胡须。他神情镇定，直视画外。白衬衫在颈间深色领结下方露出，敞开的红色翻领之间可见带花纹的棕色背心。外套肩部宽阔、袖子饱满，厚重布料由断续的栗红、砖红和深玫瑰色笔触表现。他的一只前臂较低地横在腿上，另一只手臂伸向右方，浅色手掌松弛地垂在画外的支撑处。画面下方，暖棕黄长裤形成宽阔的斜向色楔，最近的褶线沾着暗金色光。座椅与房间融进深影，没有成为逐件刻画的物体。面部和双手塑形平滑细致，夹克、背心与背景却保留短促不规则笔触和柔化边缘。光从左上及前方落下，掠过额头、脸颊、白领、指节和外套隆起的折线；肘后仍保持深暗。阴影呈暖棕而非平板黑色，令人物与富有空气感的底色交融。整体构图把端庄而放松的人物置于浅空间的土色暗场中，深红布料和少量浅色亮点成为视觉重心。
style_prompt_en: This traditional oil-paint treatment combines careful tonal modeling at the focus with loose, broken strokes across the surrounding color masses. A deep ground of umber, charcoal, and muted ochre is interrupted by one broad warm chromatic area and small ivory highlights. Contours remain readable where light touches them, then soften and disappear into neighboring darks, allowing the composition to feel atmospheric rather than cut out. Dense opaque passages sit beside thin rubbed layers, so the surface has a subtle woven and scumbled quality. Directional light from the front and one side rounds the brightest forms while warm darks absorb the outer edges. The visual rhythm is stable and intimate, with a central concentration of detail held by broad, low-contrast surrounding space.
style_prompt_zh: 这种传统油画处理把焦点处细致的明暗塑形，与周围色块中松散、断续的笔触结合起来。深棕褐、炭色和暗赭色底面由一大片暖色区域及少量象牙白亮点打断。轮廓在光照处仍清楚，随后向邻近暗部柔化消失，使构图富有空气感，而非像剪出的形状。浓厚不透明色层与薄薄擦出的底层并置，表面因而带有微妙的织物感与擦涂痕。来自前方和一侧的定向光使最亮形体圆润，暖暗部则吸收外缘。视觉节奏稳定亲近，中央集中的细节由宽阔、低反差的周边空间托住。
theme_en: A seated man in a crimson coat
theme_zh: 身穿深红外套的坐姿男子
name: William Etty
